name: Nicholas Guest
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Nicholas Haden-Guest (born May 5, 1951) is an American actor. He primarily works as a voice actor, but is best known for a TV role, as the principal in the NBC teen sitcom, USA High.
